name: Hart Lehrune
desc: An enhanced version of a Lehrune. The intense cold air surrounding the icy hammer freezes anything that enters its atmosphere, shattering even steel.

eff.name: Icebreaker Hammer
eff.desc1: Deals [50 + (Lv. x 10)] power ice damage. Damage is increased by [Lv. x 5]% if the target is stunned.
eff.desc2: Deals [50 + (Lv. x 10)] power ice damage. Extends stun duration by 1 second(s) if the target is stunned.

eff.name: Focused Breakthrough
eff.desc1: Ensures a critical hit if the target is inflicted with Frostbite.
eff.desc2: Grants a [Lv. x 10]% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Frostbite on the target.

eff.name: Encroaching Glacier
eff.desc2: Lowers target's ice resistance by [Lv. x 1] stage(s).
